text:
Situation: Dexamethasone sodium phosphate has been on the FDA shortage list since 2019-02-08 and remains Current as of 2026-10-21. The shortage lists five manufacturers: Eugia US LLC, Fresenius Kabi USA LLC, Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc., Mylan Institutional, and Somerset Therapeutics LLC. Corvale East holds 36 tablets of 1 mg dexamethasone with 5.5 days on hand; Corvale General holds 169 tablets with 25.9 days on hand. Injectable forms at both sites range from 6.3 to 19 days of supply.

Why (FDA record): FDA first posted the shortage on 2019-02-08. Eugia Pharma Specialities Limited, the registered plant for Eugia US LLC, received an OAI classification letter dated 2026-09-21, which is 2782 days after the initial shortage posting. Earlier inspections of the same plant in 2016, 2018, and 2018 were classified VAI, occurring 875, 353, and 56 days before the shortage posting respectively.

Our position: Internal transfers can stabilize supply at Corvale East without dropping Corvale General below two weeks of inventory. External purchases from listed vendors are not on the FDA shortage list and their labels do not identify a manufacturing plant we can verify.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 56 tablets of 1 mg from Corvale General to Corvale East — approved by pharmacy director (transfer request).
2. Transfer 16 vials of 10 mg/mL, 1 mL from Corvale General to Corvale East — approved by pharmacy director (transfer request).
3. Transfer 63 vials of 4 mg/mL, 5 mL from Corvale General to Corvale East — approved by pharmacy director (transfer request).

Not recommended: Purchase from Advanced Rx Pharmacy of Tennessee, LLC or Advanced Rx of Tennessee, LLC.
